title: a nice decor option
text: a nice decor option. I bought this for a "different" table decor option.  They are very fun.  They are actually square and I think typical placemats are more rectangle shaped, so I wouldn't choose to use them as placemats... I place to place the punch bowl on one, desert tower on another... the 'grass' is sort of softer... not too stiff.  I think that cleaning could be a challenge, so I would probably not to choose something too messy to put on them.  Very springy, out-of-the-ordinary, fun decor
